metadata.name: workspace-create-hero
metadata.description: Stage-3 Create-hero journey driving the AI text-to-image surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Create mode, and asserts the Create panel composes with the one-tap generation actions discovered from AIService.ListAIOperations filtered to the generation category (Generate / Transform / Inpaint / Remove object). It then types a prompt and runs Generate — and because heavy generation models are opt-in downloads that are absent in CI (the headless-acceptance decision), the run resolves to the model-install gate via ModelsService.SelectModel (install.installed == false). Asserting the install gate appears proves the full prompt -> discovery -> select-model -> hardware-fit -> install-gate wiring works against the live API. A broken AI generation-discovery RPC, a Create panel that fails to compose, a SelectModel regression, or an install gate that never surfaces all fail here. The post-install N-variation generation + send-to-canvas is the ATTENDED acceptance gate (after a real model download) per docs/internal/DECISIONS.md; the lifecycle itself (submit -> WatchJob -> fetch-variations -> compose) is unit-covered by useCreate.test/Workspace.create.test.

assert.failure_message: The Generate (text-to-image) action did not render — AIService.ListAIOperations generation-category discovery or the Create panel regressed.
